home.name: Maria G.
home.text: The whole team made my kids feel comfortable. They explained everything before starting, and there were no surprises with our Medicaid.

home.name: Daniel R.
home.text: I called in serious pain and they found me a time the same day. Dr. Khoa was gentle and clear about what I needed.

home.name: Linh T.
home.text: I appreciated how honest they were. I got a written plan with the full cost, and a payment plan made it easy.

about.name: James P.
about.text: This office has taken care of my family for years. Under Dr. Khoa it feels just as welcoming, with even more care options.

about.name: Ana S.
about.text: Another clinic could not treat my daughter's tooth and sent us here. Dr. Khoa was patient and kind with her.

about.name: Kevin N.
about.text: They answered every question and never pushed me. I finally feel confident smiling again.

emergency.name: Daniel R.
emergency.text: I called in serious pain and they found me a time the same day. Dr. Khoa was gentle and clear about what I needed.

emergency.name: Ana S.
emergency.text: Another clinic could not treat my daughter's tooth and sent us here. She was out of pain by the time we left.

emergency.name: Rosa M.
emergency.text: I had a broken tooth and no regular dentist. They saw me quickly and explained the cost before doing anything.

restorative.name: Kevin N.
restorative.text: They answered every question and never pushed me. I finally feel confident smiling again.

restorative.name: Linh T.
restorative.text: I got a written plan with the full cost before we started, and the monthly payments made it possible.

restorative.name: Tom H.
restorative.text: Dr. Khoa explained my options clearly. The bridge feels natural and nobody can tell the difference.

family.name: Maria G.
family.text: We booked the whole family on the same morning. Everyone was friendly and our Medicaid was checked before we came.

family.name: Jessica L.
family.text: My son used to be afraid of the dentist. Now he actually looks forward to his check-ups here.

family.name: James P.
family.text: Three generations of my family come here. They always explain things clearly and treat us like family.
